title: AuthorityProfile
description: Authority profile document: what a delegated child may do, one document per profile. The document is written in YAML 1.2 and is equivalent to the JSON document this schema describes. Rules that a schema cannot express are checked by the reference model.

version.description: Version of the profile document. Must be 1.

name.description: Name of the profile. It must equal the name the request references and the file name without its prefix and extension.

filesystem.description: Filesystem rules: at most one writable root, readable roots and a denylist.

writable_roots.description: Writable root: zero or one absolute path or placeholder. An empty list makes the child read-only.

readable_roots.description: Readable roots in addition to the writable root, which is always readable and need not be repeated.

deny.description: Paths or patterns that can be neither read nor written, even inside a permitted root.

shell.description: Shell rules over whole commands. Ambiguous syntax is always denied.

allow.description: Command patterns the child may run. Every command not listed is denied.

deny.description: Command patterns denied even when another entry allows them.

network.description: Network rules. An empty list means the child has no network.

allow.description: Destinations the child may reach, each with an optional port.

tools.description: Native tools and MCP tools the child may use.

allow.description: Native tool names the child may use.

deny.description: Native tool names denied even when allowed.

mcp_allow.description: MCP server and tool pairs the child may use. The tool `*` stands for every tool of the server.

mcp_deny.description: MCP server and tool pairs denied even when allowed.

on_uncovered.description: Policy for each category when no rule covers a request.

filesystem.description: Policy for an uncovered filesystem request.

shell.description: Policy for an uncovered shell request.

network.description: Policy for an uncovered network request.

tools.description: Policy for an uncovered tool request.

path_pattern.description: Absolute path, or a path that starts with a placeholder. Relative paths, parent segments and doubled separators are invalid.

root_path.description: Path pattern that names a single location: it carries no glob character.

command_pattern.description: Command pattern: `*` matches any text and `?` matches one character. It is matched against one whole command segment.

destination.description: Network destination: a host name with at least one dot, an optional leading `*.` wildcard and an optional port. IP addresses and localhost are not valid.

tool.description: Name of the tool on that server, or `*` for every tool of the server.
